text:
Jordan: Quick weekly check on Kestrel (KST-42). Heads-up: tokens down ~12% WoW, but QoQ still +9%. P95 latency crept up to ~520ms (about +45ms WoW). Spend a touch lower WoW (-6%) but cost per token jumped ~18%.

Priya: Can you paste the top metrics?

Jordan: ```
Avg tokens/day: 1.24M  (-12% WoW, +9% QoQ)
Peak RPS: 85 -> 78 (-8% WoW)
Throughput (tokens/s): 1,400 -> 1,230 (-12% WoW)
Median seq len: 256 -> 980 (ingestion change)
P50 latency: 120ms (+10ms WoW)
P95 latency: 520ms (+45ms WoW)
Error rate (4xx/5xx): 0.6% -> 1.2% (spike Tue 03:10 UTC)
Weekly spend: $2,900 (-6% WoW, +3% QoQ)
Cost / 1k tokens: $2.34 (+18% WoW)
```

Akira: I checked logs — lots of retries and long-sequence requests during Tue 03:00-04:00 UTC. Looks like a change in their ingestion/batching.

Evan: I'll link autoscaler and pod churn. Opening INC-3217 for runtime team to trace cold starts and GPU pod evictions.

Priya: They asked for an enablement on batching last week. Sequence length increase explains cost spike. Short-term suggestions: enable prefix/KV cache + opt into int8 quantization; medium-term: prompt trimming and batched hints.

Jordan: Action items:
- Evan: attach autoscaler logs to INC-3217 and note timestamps (due EOD Thu).
- Akira: draft a 1-pager playbook for enablement (batching, quant, cache) — include sample configs (due Fri).
- Priya: schedule 30m enablement session w/ Kestrel for next Tue and capture feedback for renewal note.
- BillingBot: confirm renewal date & commit utilization.

BillingBot: Next renewal in 28 days. Committed utilization at 68%. No overage alerts.

Priya: Renewal still OK but we'll flag latency + higher cost/unit in the renewal doc.

Jordan: Suggest offering a 48-hr quantization eval to demonstrate cost delta — low-friction upsell.

Akira: Example config I plan to share:
{"quantize": "int8", "batch_size": "8", "KV_cache": "true"}

Evan: INC-3217 created: https://redwood.atlassian/INC-3217 — added spike timeline + initial logs.

Jordan: Thanks all :thumbsup:. I'll follow-up after enablement + infra updates.

Priya: Adding meeting invite now :calendar:
